subjects.meaning: subject codes in array order CH EG HM IES JM YES

positions_rad.meaning: cell position label (rad, negative = toes down), sorted most negative first

positions_snapped_rad.meaning: raw snapped angle of the cell in the npz

toes_down.meaning: 1 for each person's 2 most negative positions

r2.meaning: R2 per subject x seed x position (key = passive_trial)

r2_shape.meaning: R2 after removing the mean of key and prediction

bias.meaning: mean(prediction - key) in Nm; positive = prediction above truth

sd_truth.meaning: np.std of the key in the cell, Nm

r2_med.meaning: median over the 10 seeds of R2

r2_floor0_med.meaning: median over seeds of max(R2,0) (dashboard display)

r2_shape_med.meaning: median over seeds of shape-only R2

r2_range.meaning: max - min R2 over the 10 seeds

t_window_s.meaning: i*0.01 s, time of window i from the first window

t_trial_s.meaning: (i+19)*0.01 s, time from the start of the trial

yes_m486_key.meaning: YES -0.486 rad session-2 trial: answer key (passive_trial), Nm

yes_strong_key.meaning: YES strongest position (largest SD of key): key

yes_strong_position.meaning: position label of the strongest YES cell

jm_m078_y_true_original.meaning: the model's own (buggy) target at that position

window_yes_m486_start_end_s.meaning: suggested 30 s piece [start, end] in t_window_s
